api-settings.theAccountSApiUseIs: The account's API use is shown to members with every {@workspace.one}.

keys.aKeyIsYouOnA: A key is you, on a machine: the CLI and the HTTP API. It carries a role no higher than yours and opens no {@workspace.one} you cannot.
keys.aNewKeyWithThisLabel: A new key with this label, role and {@workspace.other} —
